title: Red Line signal problem near Park Street
content: ALERT (active 07:30-10:00): Red Line trains are experiencing residual delays of 10-15 minutes northbound between South Station and Park Street due to a signal problem. Trains are running with longer headways (every 12-15 minutes instead of every 5-9). Keywords: signal failure, dispatcher hold, train bunching. Consider Orange Line via Downtown Crossing as an alternative if traveling between South Station and downtown.

title: Green Line disabled train at Copley
content: ALERT (active 09:00-09:45): A disabled train is blocking the Green Line at Copley. All branches (B, C, D, E) are seeing 8-12 minute delays in both directions. Keywords: stuck train, train malfunction, mechanical failure. Service is being recovered. Riders going inbound may consider walking from Copley to Back Bay (Orange Line) for an alternate route downtown (about 10 minute walk).

alternatives: Walk Copley -> Back Bay -> Orange Line

title: Orange Line shuttle bus replacement Forest Hills <-> Jackson Square
content: ALERT (active all day): Orange Line is running shuttle buses between Forest Hills and Jackson Square due to track work. Add 25-30 minutes to your trip if traveling on this segment. Keywords: track work, scheduled maintenance, planned diversion. Regular Orange Line service operates from Jackson Square north.

title: Severe winter weather: Red Line reduced service
content: ALERT (severe winter weather, snowstorm or blizzard): Due to a winter snowstorm with heavy snowfall and icy switches, the Red Line is operating with reduced frequency (every 15-20 minutes) and trains may experience 15-25 minute additional delays. Keywords: blizzard, heavy snow, snowfall, icy tracks, winter storm warning, ice, snow accumulation. Some surface segments north of Alewife may be subject to switch problems. UMass Boston may issue a campus delay; check campus alerts.

alternatives: Telework or commuter rail where applicable

title: Bus 8 detour due to BU construction
content: ALERT (active 06:00-22:00): Bus 8 is on detour around Boston University construction; expect 5-10 minutes additional travel time and bus stops between BU East and St Paul Street are temporarily closed. Keywords: detour, road closure, construction.

title: UMass Boston shuttle reduced frequency (finals week)
content: ALERT (active during finals week or driver-shortage periods): The JFK/UMass <-> Campus Center shuttle is running every 12-15 minutes instead of the usual 5-10 minutes due to driver shortage. Plan extra 8 minutes buffer. Keywords: finals, finals week, reduced shuttle, slow shuttle, shuttle delay, driver shortage.
